narrator.instruct: Gripping, energetic storyteller telling a heist with a twist, brisk and excited, never calm.

clipper.instruct: Cocky, sly London crook, pleased with himself, quick and cheeky.

crier.instruct: Loud town crier shouting across a market, booming and proud.

baker.instruct: Sharp market baker, suspicious and then loudly outraged.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He's cutting silver off the King's money.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: London. Coins are hammered by hand, so every edge is ragged.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So he snips a sliver off each one. Nobody notices a rough edge.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The clippings go in a jar. The coins go back out at full value.

lines.speaker: clipper
lines.text: A little off the top, sir?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: His jar of silver gets heavier every week.

lines.speaker: crier
lines.text: Bring in your old coins! By order of the Mint!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's sixteen ninety-six. In the Tower of London, the Mint strikes new coins by machine.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Shiny, round and perfect. Now picture a clipper who tries it anyway.

lines.speaker: clipper
lines.text: New coin, same old scissors.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He trims one, and pays the baker.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She runs her thumb around the edge, and stops.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Decus et tut? Where is the rest of it?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The door bangs open. Men from the Mint. And in the Tower, Isaac Newton waits.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Here's the trick. The new coins carry words around the rim.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Decus et tutamen. An ornament and a safeguard.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Cut one sliver, and the sentence breaks. Every thumb in London becomes a guard.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A ragged coin hides a theft. A written edge confesses it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Mint swapped out the old coins in just three years.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Feel the edge of a coin in your pocket. It's still standing guard.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Safeguard.
